instrumentation: uncommitted working tree after optimization 02; keyed and coalesced modern protocol-width fitting

environment.client: one modern client in the Codex in-app browser on Windows
environment.server: isolated temporary copy, Node.js, performance diagnostics enabled

comparison.interpretation: Structural, visibility, and render requests now share one animation-frame queue. Intentional horizontal overflow no longer triggers six repeated fits.

invariants.displayLatenessNote: The single over-100 ms callback occurred with perf=1 console snapshots enabled; the render itself took 0.1 ms and no protocol fit ran on steady-state phase updates.

limitations: This comparison uses the same deterministic scenario but one current browser instead of the two-browser baseline collection.
Physical sound was not measured in this layout-only run; synchronization and sound behavior are covered by the separate multi-OS perf=3 field logs.
Browser diagnostic console serialization remains enabled and can perturb callback latency.
